channels.scale_rule: After launch, keep a channel while its CPI is at or under $1.81 and its day 7 retention is at or above 15%; raise its budget by at most 20% a week; pause it when its CPI stays above $2.26 for 14 days. Budget no qualifying channel can absorb stays unspent.

phases.what_happens: positioning line and category (below); GA4 for Firebase app streams and in-app events for subscribe and day 7; attribution that covers Apple's privacy-preserving install reports; waitlist page on budgetingapp.example
store listings drafted for both stores; closed testing; creator shortlist; two web-to-app pages with the waitlist form; Play pre-registration opens in the US on its date
live in Canada only; three paid tests under the test rule; day 1, day 7, payer rate and CPI measured; US pre-order opens once the app is live in Canada
soft-launch gate decision on the first day; launch build to review by the date below; creator posts and waitlist emails scheduled
US release on both stores; waitlist email on launch morning; creator posts; paid on channels that passed the gate
one store listing test at a time; referral reward live; web-to-app pages switch from the waitlist form to store links; paid on the scale rule

soft_launch_gate.on_fail: Name the failed check, recompute the install value with the measured numbers, then either move launch day (the Play pre-registration window allows up to 30 days) or launch with paid capped at the new planning CPI.

unknowns_and_risks: The planning CPI ($1.81) rests on an assumed 5% payer rate and 80% renewal rate. If the payer rate is 25% lower, break-even falls to $1.70; the soft launch measures both before US money is spent.
Canada CPIs and retention may differ from the US. Treat the soft launch as a read on the app, then recheck CPI in the first two US weeks.
Apple Ads, App Store Connect and Play Console have no connector: their numbers come from the user's exports.
Organic installs after launch (1,200 a month) are the user's estimate with no store history behind it yet.
The App Store pre-order for the US opens after the app is live in Canada; confirm the date range App Store Connect shows for a new region.
